title: Beer Mileage
description: Turn what you walked into what you have earned to drink. Log steps, runs, rides, swims and gym time; it counts only the energy above sitting at the bar, from the Compendium of Physical Activities, and divides by the real calories in a pint of whatever you drink — alcohol at 7 kcal a gram plus the malt left behind. Ten thousand steps is a pint and a half of lager. Watch a real glass fill in 3D: refraction, a head that settles, bubbles from fixed nucleation sites, a nitro cascade for stout, and condensation only where the beer is. Tilt the phone and the beer stays level. Pour one when you have earned it.
